title: The Arbiter of Steel
description: The Arbiter challenges the party leader to single combat. Direct. Honest. Wants a real fight and will be disappointed by anything less. FIX 2026-07-28 (cowir-ai msg-3206): this scene's hospitality beat was gated on a 'completionist' branch key that _detect_playstyle CAN NEVER RETURN (it returns automator/grinder/exploiter/manual/balanced only), so it had never played for any player. The beat is unconditional in canon — W1 ch.4 has the Warden offer the guardhouse food with no condition attached — so it is now the default arm rather than a playstyle reward. Playstyle-specific arms (e.g. grinder) are untouched and still take precedence.

lines.speaker: Arbiter
lines.text: Spar with me first. Before the real thing. For calibration.

lines.speaker: Arbiter
lines.text: I challenge one of you. Whoever leads. The others stay back. I'll know if they don't.

lines.speaker: Arbiter
lines.text: Come at me with everything. I'll know if you're holding back. And I'll be disappointed.
